key_insight: MyoCardBench is a large, real-world benchmark designed to test how well LLMs handle the full cardiovascular care continuum, not just exam-style questions.
clinical_relevance: It highlights where medical LLMs can support cardiology workflows and where clinically important omissions or safety gaps remain.
method: Built 2,263 items from 13 cardiovascular task datasets using de-identified records and exam data.
16 cardiology physicians created annotations and reference answers, with cross-review by two senior cardiologists.
Seven LLMs produced 15,841 zero-shot outputs, scored with task-specific metrics for open-ended and accuracy-based tasks.
evidence_signal: Across the benchmark, GPT-5.4 led overall, while performance varied widely by task, from strong auxiliary reporting to very low ECG reading and ethics scores.
watch_item: Because performance was measured in standardized zero-shot settings on benchmark data, results may not translate directly to local clinical workflows or real-time decision support.
paper_title: MyoCardBench: A Real-World Data Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Clinically Authentic Cardiovascular Care Scenarios
